versos.hebraico: וַיִּקָּבְצ֧וּ כָֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֣וֹנָה לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֛ה עַצְמְךָ֥ וּֽבְשָׂרְךָ֖ אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

controles.web: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
controles.kjv: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
controles.livre: Então todo o Israel se ajuntou a Davi em Hebrom, dizendo: Eis que nós somos teu osso e tua carne.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־תְּמ֣וֹל גַּם־שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם גַּ֚ם בִּהְי֣וֹת שָׁא֣וּל מֶ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֛ה הַמּוֹצִ֥יא וְהַמֵּבִ֖יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לְךָ֗ אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת־עַמִּי֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. Yahweh your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”
controles.kjv: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the Lord thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
controles.livre: E mesmo antes, quando Saul ainda era rei, tu conduzias as tropas de Israel.  Também o SENHOR teu Deus te disse: Tu apascentarás o meu povo Israel, e tu serás líder do meu povo Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ כָּל־זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹת֩ לָהֶ֨ם דָּוִ֥יד בְּרִ֛ית בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּמְשְׁח֨וּ אֶת־דָּוִ֤יד לְמֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to Yahweh’s word by Samuel.
controles.kjv: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.
controles.livre: Também vieram todos os anciãos de Israel ao rei em Hebrom, e Davi fez aliança com eles diante do SENHOR; e ungiram a Davi como rei sobre Israel, conforme a palavra do SENHOR por meio de Samuel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ דָּוִ֧יד וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הִ֣יא יְב֑וּס וְשָׁם֙ הַיְבוּסִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (the same is Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
controles.kjv: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
controles.livre: Então Davi e todo Israel foram a Jerusalém, a qual era Jebus, pois ali os jebuseus eram os moradores daquela terra.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְבוּס֙ לְדָוִ֔יד לֹ֥א תָב֖וֹא הֵ֑נָּה וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֔וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃

controles.web: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You shall not come in here.” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is the city of David.
controles.kjv: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
controles.livre: E os moradores de Jebus disseram a Davi: Tu não entrarás aqui.Porém Davi conquistou a fortaleza de Sião, que é a cidade de Davi.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד כָּל־מַכֵּ֤ה יְבוּסִי֙ בָּרִ֣אשׁוֹנָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לְרֹ֖אשׁ וּלְשָׂ֑ר וַיַּ֧עַל בָּרִאשׁוֹנָ֛ה יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י לְרֹֽאשׁ׃

controles.web: David said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
controles.kjv: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
controles.livre: (Pois Davi havia dito: O primeiro a derrotar aos jebuseus será chefe e comandante.Então Joabe, filho de Zeruia, subiu primeiro, e foi feito comandante.)

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב דָּוִ֖יד בַּמְצָ֑ד עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרְאוּ־ל֖וֹ עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃

controles.web: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.
controles.kjv: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
controles.livre: E Davi habitou na fortaleza; por isso que foi chamada de cidade de Davi.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֤בֶן הָעִיר֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב מִן־הַמִּלּ֖וֹא וְעַד־הַסָּבִ֑יב וְיוֹאָ֕ב יְחַיֶּ֖ה אֶת־שְׁאָ֥ר הָעִֽיר׃

controles.web: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
controles.kjv: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
controles.livre: E ele edificou a cidade ao redor, desde as fundações do aterro  ao redor; e Joabe reparou o resto da cidade.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖יד הָל֣וֹךְ וְגָד֑וֹל וַיהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: David grew greater and greater; for Yahweh of Armies was with him.
controles.kjv: So David waxed greater and greater: for the Lord of hosts was with him.
controles.livre: E Davi ia cada vez mais crescendo em poder, pois o SENHOR dos exércitos era com ele.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֤י הַגִּבּוֹרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֔יד הַמִּתְחַזְּקִ֨ים עִמּ֧וֹ בְמַלְכוּת֛וֹ עִם־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהַמְלִיכ֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to Yahweh’s word concerning Israel.
controles.kjv: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
controles.livre: Estes foram os líderes dos guerreiros que Davi teve, os que lhe deram forte apoio em seu reinado, com todo Israel, para o fazerem rei sobre Israel, conforme a palavra do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה מִסְפַּ֥ר הַגִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֑יד יָשָׁבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־חַכְמוֹנִ֗י רֹ֚אשׁ השלושים הֽוּא־עוֹרֵ֧ר אֶת־חֲנִית֛וֹ עַל־שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת חָלָ֖ל בְּפַ֥עַם אֶחָֽת׃

controles.web: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
controles.kjv: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
controles.livre: E este é o número dos guerreiros que Davi teve: Jasobeão, filho de Hacmoni, chefe de capitães, o qual, fazendo uso de sua lança, matou trezentos de um vez.

versos.hebraico: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן־דּוֹד֖וֹ הָאֲחוֹחִ֑י ה֖וּא בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃

controles.web: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
controles.kjv: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
controles.livre: E depois dele Eleazar, filho de Dodô, o aoíta; ele era um dos três principais guerreiros.

versos.hebraico: הֽוּא־הָיָ֨ה עִם־דָּוִ֜יד בַּפַּ֣ס דַּמִּ֗ים וְהַפְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ נֶאֱסְפוּ־שָׁ֣ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַתְּהִ֛י חֶלְקַ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מְלֵאָ֣ה שְׂעוֹרִ֑ים וְהָעָ֥ם נָ֖סוּ מִפְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

controles.web: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
controles.kjv: He was with David at Pas–dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
controles.livre: Este esteve com Davi em Pas-Damim, quando os filisteus se ajuntaram para a batalha; e havia ali uma plantação cheia de cevada. Enquanto o povo fugia dos filisteus,

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֤וּ בְתוֹךְ־הַחֶלְקָה֙ וַיַּצִּיל֔וּהָ וַיַּכּ֖וּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיּ֥וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֖ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃

controles.web: They stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh saved them by a great victory.
controles.kjv: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.
controles.livre: Eles se puseram no meio da plantação, defenderam-na, e derrotaram  os Filisteus; e o SENHOR lhes deu uma grande vitória.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּרְד֡וּ שְֽׁלוֹשָׁה֩ מִן־הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים רֹ֤אשׁ עַל־הַצֻּר֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֔יד אֶל־מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃

controles.web: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
controles.kjv: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
controles.livre: E três dos trinta comandantes desceram a Davi, na rocha junto à caverna de Adulão, enquanto o acampamento dos filisteus estava no vale de Refaim.

versos.hebraico: וְדָוִ֖יד אָ֣ז בַּמְּצוּדָ֑ה וּנְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בְּבֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃

controles.web: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
controles.kjv: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison was then at Beth–lehem.
controles.livre: E Davi estava então na fortaleza, enquanto havia uma tropa de filisteus em Belém.

versos.hebraico: ויתאו דָּוִ֖יד וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מִ֚י יַשְׁקֵ֣נִי מַ֔יִם מִבּ֥וֹר בֵּֽית־לֶ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃

controles.web: David longed, and said, “Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
controles.kjv: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth–lehem, that is at the gate!
controles.livre: Davi teve um desejo, e disse: Quem me dera beber da água do poço de Belém, que está junto à porta!

versos.hebraico: וַיִּבְקְע֨וּ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֜ה בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ־מַ֨יִם֙ מִבּ֤וֹר בֵּֽית־לֶ֨חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשַּׁ֔עַר וַיִּשְׂא֖וּ וַיָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל־דָּוִ֑יד וְלֹֽא־אָבָ֤ה דָוִיד֙ לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֔ם וַיְנַסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahweh,
controles.kjv: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth–lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the Lord,
controles.livre: E aqueles três irromperam pelo acampamento dos filisteus, e tiraram água do poço de Belém, que está junto à porta, tomaram dela, e a trouxeram a Davi. Davi, porém não a quis beber; em vez disso, derramou-a ao SENHOR,

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר חָלִילָה֩ לִּ֨י מֵאֱלֹהַ֜י מֵעֲשׂ֣וֹת זֹ֗את הֲדַ֣ם הָאֲנָשִׁים֩ הָאֵ֨לֶּה אֶשְׁתֶּ֤ה בְנַפְשׁוֹתָם֙ כִּ֣י בְנַפְשׁוֹתָ֣ם הֱבִיא֔וּם וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה עָשׂ֔וּ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃

controles.web: and said, “My God forbid it me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
controles.kjv: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
controles.livre: E disse: Deus me proíba de fazer isto! Beberia eu o sangue destes homens com suas vidas? Pois eles arriscaram suas vidas para a trazerem.Por isso ele não a quis beber. Isto fizeram aqueles três guerreiros.

versos.hebraico: וְאַבְשַׁ֣י אֲחִֽי־יוֹאָ֗ב ה֤וּא הָיָה֙ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה וְהוּא֙ עוֹרֵ֣ר אֶת־חֲנִית֔וֹ עַל־שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָלָ֑ל ולא־שֵׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁלוֹשָֽׁה׃

controles.web: Abishai, the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
controles.kjv: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
controles.livre: E também Abisai, irmão de Joabe, foi o cabeça de três, o qual usando sua lança sobre trezentos, ele os matou; e foi famoso entre os três.

versos.hebraico: מִן־הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֤ה בַשְּׁנַ֨יִם֙ נִכְבָּ֔ד וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לְשָׂ֑ר וְעַד־הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה לֹֽא־בָֽא׃ס

controles.web: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain: however he didn’t attain to the three.
controles.kjv: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
controles.livre: Dos três ele foi mais ilustre que os outros dois, por isso foi seu cabeça; porém não alcançou os três primeiros .

versos.hebraico: בְּנָיָ֨ה בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָ֧ע בֶּן־אִֽישׁ־חַ֛יִל רַב־פְּעָלִ֖ים מִֽן־קַבְצְאֵ֑ל ה֣וּא הִכָּ֗ה אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י אֲרִיאֵל֙ מוֹאָ֔ב וְ֠הוּא יָרַ֞ד וְהִכָּ֧ה אֶֽת־הָאֲרִ֛י בְּת֥וֹךְ הַבּ֖וֹר בְּי֥וֹם הַשָּֽׁלֶג׃

controles.web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, he killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab: he went down also and killed a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow.
controles.kjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
controles.livre: Também Benaia, filho de Joiada, filho de homem valente, de grandes feitos, de Cabzeel; ele matou dois dos poderosos guerreiros de Moabe; ele também desceu, e matou um leão dentro de uma cova no tempo da neve.

versos.hebraico: וְהֽוּא־הִכָּה֩ אֶת־הָאִ֨ישׁ הַמִּצְרִ֜י אִ֥ישׁ מִדָּ֣ה׀ חָמֵ֣שׁ בָּאַמָּ֗ה וּבְיַ֨ד הַמִּצְרִ֤י חֲנִית֙ כִּמְנ֣וֹר אֹרְגִ֔ים וַיֵּ֥רֶד אֵלָ֖יו בַּשָּׁ֑בֶט וַיִּגְזֹ֤ל אֶֽת־הַחֲנִית֙ מִיַּ֣ד הַמִּצְרִ֔י וַיַּהַרְגֵ֖הוּ בַּחֲנִיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
controles.kjv: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
controles.livre: Ele também matou um homem egípcio alto, de cinco côvados; o egípcio trazia na mão uma lança como um lançador de tecelão; porém Benaia desceu a ele com um bastão; e arrancou a lança da mão do egípcio, e o matou com sua própria lança.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה עָשָׂ֔ה בְּנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וְלוֹ־שֵׁ֖ם בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃

controles.web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.
controles.kjv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
controles.livre: Estas coisas fez Benaia, filho de Joiada, e por isso foi famoso entre aqueles três guerreiros.

versos.hebraico: מִן־הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁ֗ים הִנּ֤וֹ נִכְבָּד֙ ה֔וּא וְאֶל־הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־בָ֑א וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ דָוִ֖יד עַל־מִשְׁמַעְתּֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three: and David set him over his guard.
controles.kjv: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
controles.livre: Eis que ele foi o mais ilustre dos trinta, mas não alcançou os três primeiros . E Davi o pôs sobre sua guarda pessoal.

versos.hebraico: וְגִבּוֹרֵ֖י הַחֲיָלִ֑ים עֲשָׂה־אֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב אֶלְחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־דּוֹד֖וֹ מִבֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃ס

controles.web: Also the mighty men of the armies: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
controles.kjv: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth–lehem,
controles.livre: E os guerreiros dos exército foram: Asael, irmão de Joabe; Elanã filho de Dodô de Belém;

versos.hebraico: שַׁמּוֹת֙ הַהֲרוֹרִ֔י חֶ֖לֶץ הַפְּלוֹנִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
controles.kjv: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
controles.livre: Samote o harodita; Helez o pelonita;

versos.hebraico: עִירָ֤א בֶן־עִקֵּשׁ֙ הַתְּקוֹעִ֔י אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר הָעֲנְּתוֹתִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
controles.kjv: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi–ezer the Antothite,
controles.livre: Ira, filho de Iques, o tecoíta; Abiezer o anatotita;

versos.hebraico: סִבְּכַי֙ הַחֻ֣שָׁתִ֔י עִילַ֖י הָאֲחוֹחִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
controles.kjv: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
controles.livre: Sibecai o husatita; Ilai o aoíta;

versos.hebraico: מַהְרַי֙ הַנְּטֹ֣פָתִ֔י חֵ֥לֶד בֶּֽן־בַּֽעֲנָ֖ה הַנְּטוֹפָתִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
controles.kjv: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
controles.livre: Maarai o netofatita; Helede, filho de Baaná, o netofatita;

versos.hebraico: אִיתַ֣י בֶּן־רִיבַ֗י מִגִּבְעַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ןס בְּנָיָ֖ה הַפִּרְעָתֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
controles.kjv: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
controles.livre: Itai, filho de Ribai, de Gibeá dos filhos de Benjamim; Benaia o piratonita;

versos.hebraico: חוּרַי֙ מִנַּ֣חֲלֵי גָ֔עַשׁס אֲבִיאֵ֖ל הָעַרְבָתִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
controles.kjv: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
controles.livre: Hurai do ribeiro de Gaás; Abiel, o arbatita;

versos.hebraico: עַזְמָ֨וֶת֙ הַבַּ֣חֲרוּמִ֔י אֶלְיַחְבָּ֖א הַשַּׁעַלְבֹנִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
controles.kjv: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
controles.livre: Azmavete, o baarumita; Eliaba, o saalbonita;

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֗י הָשֵׁם֙ הַגִּ֣זוֹנִ֔י יוֹנָתָ֥ן בֶּן־שָׁגֵ֖ה הַהֲרָרִֽי׃ס

controles.web: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
controles.kjv: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
controles.livre: Os filhos de Hasém, o gizonita; Jônatas, filho de Sage, o hararita;

versos.hebraico: אֲחִיאָ֧ם בֶּן־שָׂכָ֛ר הַהֲרָרִ֖י אֱלִיפַ֥ל בֶּן־אֽוּר׃ס

controles.web: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
controles.kjv: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
controles.livre: Aião filho de Sacar, o hararita; Elifal filho de Ur;

versos.hebraico: חֵ֚פֶר הַמְּכֵ֣רָתִ֔י אֲחִיָּ֖ה הַפְּלֹנִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
controles.kjv: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
controles.livre: Héfer, o mequeratita; Aías, o pelonita;

versos.hebraico: חֶצְרוֹ֙ הַֽכַּרְמְלִ֔י נַעֲרַ֖י בֶּן־אֶזְבָּֽי׃ס

controles.web: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
controles.kjv: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
controles.livre: Hezro, o carmelita; Naarai, filho de Ezbai;

versos.hebraico: יוֹאֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י נָתָ֔ן מִבְחָ֖ר בֶּן־הַגְרִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
controles.kjv: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
controles.livre: Joel, irmão de Natã; Mibar, filho de Hagri;

versos.hebraico: צֶ֖לֶק הָעַמּוֹנִ֑י נַחְרַי֙ הַבֵּ֣רֹתִ֔י נֹשֵׂ֕א כְּלֵ֖י יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
controles.kjv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
controles.livre: Zeleque, o amonita; Naarai, o berotita, escudeiro de Joabe filho de Zeruia;

versos.hebraico: עִירָא֙ הַיִּתְרִ֔י גָּרֵ֖ב הַיִּתְרִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
controles.kjv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
controles.livre: Ira, o itrita; Garebe, o itrita;

versos.hebraico: אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַחִתִּ֔י זָבָ֖ד בֶּן־אַחְלָֽי׃ס

controles.web: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
controles.kjv: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
controles.livre: Urias, o heteu; Zabade, filho de Alai;

versos.hebraico: עֲדִינָ֨א בֶן־שִׁיזָ֜א הָרֽאוּבֵנִ֗י רֹ֛אשׁ לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְעָלָ֥יו שְׁלוֹשִֽׁים׃ס

controles.web: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
controles.kjv: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
controles.livre: Adina, filho de Siza, o rubenita, o qual era chefe dos rubenitas, e com ele trinta;

versos.hebraico: חָנָן֙ בֶּֽן־מַעֲכָ֔ה וְיוֹשָׁפָ֖ט הַמִּתְנִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Hanan the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
controles.kjv: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
controles.livre: Hanã, filho de Maaca; Josafá o mitenita;

versos.hebraico: עֻזִיָּ֖א הָעֲשְׁתְּרָתִ֑י שָׁמָע֙ ויעואלס בְּנֵ֖י חוֹתָ֥ם הָעֲרֹעֵרִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
controles.kjv: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
controles.livre: Uzia, o asteratia; Sama e Jeiel, filhos de Hotão, o aroerita;

versos.hebraico: יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ בֶּן־שִׁמְרִ֔י וְיֹחָ֥א אָחִ֖יו הַתִּיצִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
controles.kjv: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
controles.livre: Jedaiel, filho de Sinri, e seu irmão Joá, o tizita;

versos.hebraico: אֱלִיאֵל֙ הַֽמַּחֲוִ֔ים וִירִיבַ֥י וְיוֹשַׁוְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְנָ֑עַם וְיִתְמָ֖ה הַמּוֹאָבִֽי׃

controles.web: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
controles.kjv: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
controles.livre: Eliel, o maavita; Jeribai e Josavias, filhos de Elnaão; Itma, o moabita;

versos.hebraico: אֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְעוֹבֵ֔ד וְיַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל הַמְּצֹבָיָֽה׃פ

controles.web: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
controles.kjv: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
controles.livre: Eliel; Obede; e Jaasiel, o mezobaíta.
